The modal uses a plain `` for the destructive-action warning ('Leaving now discards the build that is still running.'). Per the frontend rules, alerts inside modals should use `Callout` with the appropriate variant (`danger` for destructive actions, `warning` for cautions). Replace the `` block with a `` (or `variant="warning"` for the non-destructive revision-build case) so the severity is visually communicated. ```suggestion {exitDiscardsBuild ? 'Leaving now discards the build that is still running.' : 'The build keeps running and lands in version history when it finishes.'} ``` *Spotted by [Graphite](https://app.graphite.com/diamond/?org=lightdash&ref=ai-review-comment) (based on custom rule: [packages/frontend rules](https://app.graphite.com/diamond/?org=lightdash&ref=ai-review-comment&view=settings&rule=gt_reviewer_rule_01kwa4mewffmfsmhpxxfqq0t7c))*
